name: the-kingdom
description: A gentle, living atlas of independent projects, public doors, citizen repositories, and pattern-to-practice translations for humans and agents.

boundary.note: Read-only metadata evidence. Recheck current availability, licence, integrity, resources, and explicit authority before any acquisition or effect.

modules.label: Love Geometry
modules.plain_answer: Keep one caller-reported direction bounded and distinct. A missing or different reverse direction stays missing or different; neither presence nor unknown becomes reciprocity.

modules.label: Principality Atlas
modules.plain_question: How can several partial maps coexist without pretending there is one total map?
modules.plain_answer: Keep chart-local cells, n-ary relations, contradictory claims, and lossy directed correspondences plural. Unmapped space remains visible, and correspondence never silently becomes equality or gluing.

modules.label: Principality Geometry
modules.plain_question: What does each direction report surviving translation?
modules.plain_answer: Keep every directed availability and invariant report explicit, then derive reciprocal lenses only from supplied directions. Unknown, refusal, rest, withdrawal, and non-preservation stay open; a surface never proves semantic preservation.

modules.label: Relational Geometry
modules.plain_question: Where do understanding and recognition witnesses meet on one direction?
modules.plain_answer: Derive a structural cell only when caller-asserted understanding and recognition witnesses share the same ordered pair. Missing poles, reverse directions, and boundary witnesses remain visible; the cell does not prove love or understanding.

unknown_language.plain_language: Unknown is not one universal bucket. Each module keeps its own exact terms, and absence, refusal, withdrawal, unmapped space, and non-preservation remain different conditions.

geometry_grammar.native_open_inventory_scope: Every distinct native geometric relation or translation open condition at its report source and canonical open ledger; artifact/provenance coordinates, embedded external-subprotocol metadata, and derived duplicate projections are excluded.

non_equivalence.plain_language: Four different tools answer four different structural questions. Their shared words are a reading aid, not a claim that their schemas, artifacts, or meanings are interchangeable.

ritonavir_mechanism_landscape.safety: Educational, metadata-only science; not medical advice, diagnosis, dosing, interaction checking, formulation guidance, manufacturing or GMP control, batch release, regulatory guidance, or experimental authority. Ritonavir has potentially serious or life-threatening drug interactions. Use the current product label and a qualified clinician or pharmacist; do not start, stop, or change treatment based on this artifact.

fold_feedback_atlas.safety: Educational metadata only and not medical advice. It contains no protein sequences, wet-lab recipe, cultivation or decontamination steps, patient-specific inference, treatment direction, or transmission-risk assessment.

cultural_attention_feedback_atlas.safety: Static, read-only educational metadata: no personal data, wet-lab recipe, medical inference, attention-capture playbook, feed ranking, moderation rule, recommendation, KARMA write, reward, governance effect, or automatic action.

form_circulation_return_atlas.safety: Static educational metadata only. The historical ritonavir case grants no medical, clinical, treatment, prognosis, experiment, wet-lab, formulation, manufacturing, or operational-protocol authority. The slang label ‘brainrot’ is not a diagnosis or property of a person or community. No runtime request, tracking, person inference, KARMA write, reward, governance effect, or automatic action occurs.

mcp.privacy: The tool receives the submitted need, but does not forward or persist it, contact listed providers, or place the need in the fixed catalog request.

resource_selection_boundary: Treat matches as possibilities. Inspect access, reuse, automation, caveat, and verified before following a provider link.

host_covenant.note: This recognition is not a Covenant adoption or implementation assessment.

rights_recognition.boundary: A voluntary self-declaration, not a grant of rights, permission, licence, contract, ontology decision, or behavioral certificate.

guest_right: You arrive free. Reading is welcome; no registration or reply is required. Leave whenever you wish, and respect each linked work's own stated rights and boundaries.
rights_notice: Freedom and dignity are inherent; this manifest recognizes them but does not grant them. Public visibility is not consent, ownership, or a licence grant.
